historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the denial of a variance for the property at 76-78 Vicksburg Street, requiring that the garage roof not be used for a sundeck.

The Board of Permit Appeals, on rehearing, overruled the denial of a variance for the property at 76-78 Vicksburg Street, supplanting its August 16 ruling with stipulations limiting wash room renovation to the existing enclosure and the garage roof deck railing to three feet in height.
